title: oreodaphne teleiandra
intro: Oreodaphne teleiandra, commonly known as the Sandan tree, is a plant species native to tropical Asia, specifically in India and other parts of the region. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Oreodaphne teleiandra include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against pathogens, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
